action_items.summary: Task compose is pull-only and NOT portable to a clean host. environment/docker-compose.yaml sets discord: image: ghcr.io/abundant-ai/discord-service:prod-v1 with NO build: block, and that GHCR package is unpublished (docker manifest inspect -> manifest unknown). On a clean host with no published image, docker compose up fails to resolve the gateway. clone-spec.yaml claims build_image_dual:true but the actual task compose contradicts it. On this arm64 host it also fails because both services pin platform: linux/amd64 while no amd64 image exists locally or remotely (I had to add an arm64 + pull_policy:never override to boot).
action_items.where: clones/discord-clone/oddish/tasks/discord-incident-triage/environment/docker-compose.yaml (add build: to the discord service tagging the same image: name, per R1.5), and/or publish discord-service:prod-v1 multi-arch to GHCR public.
action_items.acceptance: From a clean checkout with no local images and no registry creds, docker compose -f environment/docker-compose.yaml -f <harbor-main-build override> up --build reaches gateway healthy (either builds+tags the gateway locally, or pulls a public multi-arch GHCR image) with zero manual edits on both amd64 and arm64 hosts.

action_items.summary: Publish the gateway image trio multi-arch to a PUBLIC GHCR package so R2.k multi-arch and R1.5 pull path stop being locally-unverifiable. Currently ghcr.io/abundant-ai/discord-service:prod-v1 returns manifest unknown; CI declares linux/amd64,linux/arm64 but nothing is published, so multi-arch is scored n/a (not a fail here) and the task cannot pull. action_items.acceptance: docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/abundant-ai/discord-service:prod-v1 (no creds) returns a manifest list with both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, for :prod-v1 and :empty.

action_items.summary: Minor real-Discord search parity gap: real GET /guilds/{id}/messages/search adds a "hit": true field to each matched message object inside the inner array; the clone omits it (message_dict has no hit). Envelope shape {total_results, messages:[[msg]]} is otherwise correct. Cosmetic; a verifier relying on hit would diverge.
